title: Spectral sequence realizing the additive Postnikov pages
statement: Let A and B be abelian categories, and suppose D(A) is a derived category with its standard t-structure. For any PostnikovPageData P, there exists PostnikovSpectralData P: a functor to Mathlib E2 cohomological spectral sequences whose page objects, differentials, maps and homology transitions agree with the iterated exact couples. The witness interfaces are defined in [def-per-postnikov-additive-witness-data].

source.place: Tags 011S and 0AMJ: iteration of the derived couple and the bigraded spectral sequence; Mathlib SpectralSequence packages the same page complexes.

proof.text: At page s≥2 place the (s-2)-fold derived E terms in a bigraded complex, with the couple differential in the slot of bidegree (s,1-s) and zero elsewhere. The couple differential squares to zero. Identify cycles with the outgoing kernel and homology with the cokernel of the incoming differential lifted to that kernel, hence the next derived E term. The couple-morphism f/g squares give chain maps, and the given homology square gives their transition compatibility. Functor laws follow from the additive page functors. Uses [lem-sp-derived-couple-exact], [def-sp-spectral-sequence].
